head: b2afb6e2e60695f75ed0dbae21e9fde691bf926c
scope: Sampled current capability census, not complete whole-repository or filesystem universe
states: READY_IMPLEMENT: inputs and relevant code exist but a new adapter/tests are needed. INPUT_DEPENDENT: a named missing input or source qualification remains. No existing CLI was qualified READY_RUN for a new nonduplicate empirical result in this task.
resource_estimates: Not measured runtimes; benchmark selectedstage before expensive dispatch
exclusions: Do not repeat the accepted SMICA disjoint pilot, CF4 response or DESI scalar results, or completed historical SDSS/CF3/Union3 extractions unchanged. Every row names a new discriminator or input qualification.
new_locator_information: The old /mnt/sn850x2t raw location is absent, but workdir/raw/planck_ffp10 resolves to /mnt/extdrive/workdir/raw/planck_ffp10. Sample CMB/noise FITS files exist (603,987,840 bytes each). Earlier old-locator absence is not global raw unavailability.
discovery_method: Read canonical AGENTS, blockers, current handoff and actual entrypoints; DAG completion does not confer scientific admission.
Enumerate scripts, observable/inference modules, tests, and direct children of raw/compact/bundle input roots with rg; avoid giant archives.
For each candidate, resolve inputs from code/provenance, inspect actual file/symlink status, then read small NPZ shapes or FITS headers.
Bind a new scientific question to the existing result and its admitted law; exclude unchanged repetitions of accepted work.
Expand the queue from the actual bundle INDEX, available dataset registries, pending cards and unexamined modules, recording coverage and missing inputs.
Run the smallest useful new result, validate and review it, then continue; missing inputs block their own branches rather than the entire queue.
coverage_gaps: Not all canonical pending PR cards were read.
HSC/KiDS directories were present, but their product files, readers and laws were not reviewed.
DESI raw/mocks and CF4 new analyses remain with parent’s audit.
JWST-SN registry/admission gap was not repaired.
No exhaustive alternate-location search for Gaia, Union3 or SDSS raw inputs.
No claimed complete whole-repository universe or numerical eligibility.

opportunities.name: ACT DR6 strict-in-band modulation rank
opportunities.entrypoint: Implement a cache-only adapter. Existing producer accepts --phase check/aggregate; do not overwrite the historical card.
opportunities.tests: Existing PR177 validation: scripts/codex_harness/run_pr177_act_dr6_inband_modulation.py.
opportunities.current_filesystem_evidence: 401 cached JSON units contain data and 400 simulation five-vectors. The existing card has no scientific result.
opportunities.admitted_scope: Delivered reconstructed-kappa model, strict 41–762 support; exploratory internal result.
opportunities.next_result: Rank a fixed modulation score on disjoint training/calibration units; compare raw and mask-controlled features.
opportunities.stage_resource_estimate: S1; less than 2 MB; seconds.
